comment: Server side of the wasm-client-vs-native-server harness (.github/tests/web/run_webrtc_web_client_test.sh). Same --listen-driven connection as dummy_plug_net_webrtc_server.json, but with a much longer end_time: that config's peer is a second *native* process (fast cold start), while this one's peer is a headless-Chromium wasm client -- cold Emscripten+WebGL boot plus SwiftShader warm-up plus the WebRTC handshake all have to fit inside this window before the server self-closes, or the run fails on a timeout instead of a real assertion. end_time sized to match the CI job's own BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS+CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS margin (60s+90s=150s, see .github/workflows/10-compile.yml's Test_webrtc_wasm_client) so a slow CI runner doesn't have the server close out from under a client that's still mid-boot.
